title: Phase 6: Phase-Centric UX Polish

title: Phase 0: Lock Core Invariants

title: Create 3DTransformAnimation factory and React component

title: Decouple color from SVG path data
description:
SVG paths should not have any inherent color. Color must be added by a ColorField primitive block.

Current state:
- LineData has a `color` field
- SVGPathSource includes colors in `meta.colors`
- Downstream blocks can use those colors

Target state:
1. SVGPathSource outputs paths without color (or ignores color field)
2. Color comes from a `ColorField` block in the Fields lane
3. Renderers consume color from the field, not the scene metadata

This decouples path geometry from visual styling, making the system more composable.
